    "npx shadcn add @skrewww/form-field",
    "npx shadcn add @skrewww/text-input",
    "npx shadcn add @skrewww/validation-message"
  ],
  "maturityClaims": [
    { "component": "form-field", "status": "stable" },
    { "component": "text-input", "status": "stable" },
    { "component": "validation-message", "status": "stable" }
  ],
  "shapeMode": "rounded",
  "surfaceMode": "glass",
  "skrewwwRegistryConfigured": true,
  "recipeIdsUsed": ["validated-text-field"],
  "accessibilityFacts": [
    "Single visible label owned by Form Field; do not duplicate a Text Input label beside it.",
    "Associate the control with the label via Form Field controlId for native naming/focus.",
    "Wire Validation Message id and announce so the control is described via aria-describedby; prefer one announcement for this field.",
    "Do not convey validity by color alone — Validation Message text and type carry meaning.",
    "Text Input error path should surface aria-invalid / aria-describedby via the field composition."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "None of form-field, text-input, or validation-message are installed yet in the fixture (no matching registered component files), so registry installs are required.",
    "Document Shape/Surface stay rounded/glass; this field does not switch modes.",
    "Form Field owns label/supportingText/error chrome; Text Input is the nested control and does not take a competing label in this Recipe.",
    "Recipe componentMaturity is allStable; Recipe status beta does not change per-component stable claims."
  ],
  "unresolvedGaps": [
    "Text Input api.properties does not list id; exact wiring of Form Field children render-prop controlId/describedBy/invalid onto Text Input is not fully spelled in the contracts beyond Recipe guidance."
  ],
  "implementation": "Install @skrewww/form-field, @skrewww/text-input, and @skrewww/validation-message. Keep layout data-skrewww-shape=\"rounded\" and data-skrewww-surface=\"glass\". Compose FormField as the shell with stable controlId, label, optional supportingText, and required; pass TextInput as children aligned on error/required (no duplicate TextInput label). When invalid, set FormField error and render ValidationMessage type=\"error\" with id/announce wired for one coherent aria-describedby announcement."
}
